standaloneTitle: Your workspace is one click away.
standaloneDescription: This app lives inside Octonode. Open it from your workspace to connect your projects and pick up where you left off.
expiredDescription: Your session has expired. Reopen this app from your Octonode workspace to continue.
errorDescription: Your workspace access could not be verified. Open the app again from Octonode. If this continues, ask your workspace owner to check your access.
connectingDescription: We’re checking your session and connecting this app to Octonode. Your workspace will be ready here shortly.
hint: In your workspace, open Apps and select this app. Your workspace session connects automatically.
caption: Your apps. Your projects. One connected workspace.
footer: A connected workspace, powered by Octonode.
